entries.3352fc0e0d86423e: This B2B lead generation tool uses IM-DMP audience data to extract groups of companies with keywords considered to indicate high purchase needs for products, and provides company lists in real time.
entries.3ba8aeb046d8780f: A company that supports corporate marketing and data utilization with "IM-DMP," its own platform that collects audience data.
entries.5e8008309bd223d3: This consists of a one-stop service using IM-DMP data, which covers everything from consulting to ad delivery and operation, and an ad delivery service via the IM Post-Cookie Ad Network.

entries.bc4d12387e0f59fc: Ad delivery operators such as DSPs and SSPs
entries.f3ca31d753ee11ef: This service uses IM-DMP filtering technology to extract users estimated to be likely to achieve outcomes such as purchases and operates display advertising for them. Fees are charged according to the number of performance indicators achieved.
